lesson: In confmerge/merge.py, _deep_merge_dict must combine list values using union_lists_dedup_base_order rather than replacing them or naively appending them with extend(). Merging must perform a de-duplicated union that preserves the order of items from the base list first.
why: List replacement wiped out essential base middleware like auth, while naive appending lacked idempotency and caused duplicate items to accumulate on every configuration reload.
